blocks.alt: alive wellness retreat europe

blocks.text: Alive Wellness Retreats Europe is based at a dreamy luxury health spa resort in Marbella, open year-round so you can begin your transformation whenever you’re ready. Easy for our Uk, European and UAE guests to get to the health and wellness retreat within a few hours.
Here, guests experience the best of both worlds — the elegance and comfort of a luxury beachside spa resort combined with an outstanding, personalised health and wellness program.

Nestled by the sea and surrounded by stunning tropical views, the retreat features a large outdoor pool, state-of-the-art wellness and spa facilities, large garden views, sun lounges, water sports and peaceful spaces to restore mind and body. Guests stay in private suites with ensuite bathrooms, ensuring complete privacy and calm throughout their stay.
With a full schedule of daily wellness classes, one-on-one therapies, and continuous professional support, this is more than a retreat — it’s the ultimate sanctuary for renewal, health, and balance.

blocks.text: Immerse Yourself In Nature & Adventure Outdoors
Where is the luxury health retreat located?

At the Alive luxury wellness retreat, guests have the unique opportunity to immerse themselves in the breathtaking beauty of Marbella, Spain and the great outdoors while finding mindfulness and peace in nature. The Alive Retreat is located directly on the golden mile with easy access to beaches. Whether it's a serene beach stroll along the golden sands, hiking the stunning mountains or wandering through picturesque Spanish villages on a day trip, each moment spent outside serves to reconnect them with their bodies and the world around them. Adventurous spirits can engage in activities like stand-up paddle boarding, kayaking, or boating, all of which provide a perfect blend of excitement and tranquility. As they release tension and embrace the enchanting landscapes, our guests rediscover a sense of harmony within themselves, leaving behind the hustle and bustle of everyday life.
